findings_resolved: Capture and reconstruction reject output overlap with explicit sources, declared missing originals, inventory roots and actual local plan/package/recipe inputs before directory creation.
Independent reconstruction validates plan/schema/status/path uniqueness and historical inventories without requiring vanished foreign originals.
Directory snapshot membership/stat bindings, included original capture stats and exact compressor metadata are checked against the plan.
Relative empty/dot paths, noncanonical/control-character paths, symlinks and special local inputs are refused. NUL-containing bodies use encoded parts.
The executing recipe hash is pinned before and after capture/reconstruction; package membership and original length/SHA are checked independently.
limits: This is byte preservation and reconstruction, never theorem/build/audit/kernel acceptance. Actual capture plans and terminal evidence quiescence remain the coordinator responsibility.

Recorded foreign source/missing/inventory paths are protected lexically during cross-machine verification. They are not resolved through unrelated destination-host symlinks. Actual local package, recipe and output paths are canonical and symlink-free. Use a newly owned proof-object destination.

Coordinated nonhostile filesystem writers are assumed; this is not transactional security against concurrent privileged path mutation. fsync follows the OS/filesystem contract and does not guarantee hardware retention.
No actual final capture, Lean/checker run, runtime/source/build/control mutation or Git/index change occurred in this review.
scope: Read-only review of the exact supplemental evidence capture and cross-machine reconstruction recipe; no actual terminal evidence captured and no proof gate executed.

validation_observed.cross_machine_cases: Small JSON, NUL/binary, empty original, and 6 MB large XZ original.
validation_observed.evidence_basis: Read owner-provided pinned reports/logs and inspected source; did not rerun tests or perform an actual capture.

verified_properties: Explicit parent-reviewed file/absence/inventory plan; phase and selected scope/amendment identities remain recorded. No Lean, Git, network or subprocess invocation.
New destinations only, exclusive no-follow file creation, file and directory fsync, partial failures retained without a success receipt or overwrite.
Small NUL-free UTF-8 bodies are copied exactly; large/binary originals use ordered canonical bounded base64 parts. Phase 2/3 uses single-stream XZ preset 3 / CRC64 only when smaller.

Bounded decompression rejects trailing or concatenated XZ, validates encoded and original complete byte lengths and hashes, and reads reconstructed outputs back before issuing a reconstruction receipt.
All semantic base64 parts are permanent evidence, distinct from disposable transport. Index files over the strict Git size limit fail closed.
